scope: Compare the ratio of isolated-target-weighted incident speeds for the source alone with paired held-mouth loads and the independently measured exterior force ratio, at extent 48 and separations 4 and 8.
command:
setsid --fork --wait nohup python3 scripts/s11c_guarded_run.py --pool held-pair-gap --memory-gib 1 --log-directory _scratch/s11c/held_pair_ratio_gap02 -- python3 -c 'import json
from pathlib import Path

folder = Path("docs/_measurements")
target = json.loads((folder/"lateral_target_rate.json").read_text())
run, = [r for r in target["runs"] if r["stdout"][0].startswith("extent=48 ")]
rows = [dict(w.split("=") for w in line.split()) for line in run["stdout"] if line.lstrip().startswith("d=") and " J_t=0.25 " in line]
by_d = {int(r["d"]):r for r in rows}
assert set(by_d)=={4,8}
exterior = json.loads((folder/"held_pair_exterior_balance.json").read_text())
row, = [dict(w.split("=") for w in line.split()) for line in exterior["comparison"]["stdout"]
        if line.startswith("extent=48 ") and "outer8_over_4" in line]
R = float(row["outer8_over_4"])
def ratio(column):
    return float(by_d[8][column])/float(by_d[4][column])
inc, held, carry = [ratio(k) for k in ("incident_reference", "total", "carried")]
print(f"exterior_ratio={R:.12g} shortfall_percentage_points={100*(0.25-R):.9g} relative_shortfall_percent={100*(1-4*R):.9g}")
print(f"source_only_weighted_velocity_ratio={inc:.12g} paired_mouth_ratio={held:.12g} carried_ratio={carry:.12g} fraction_of_paired_ratio_shortfall_already_in_source_only_reference={(0.25-inc)/(0.25-held):.9g}")
'
